description: This file defines the UnivariateFunction interface in the Apache Commons Math library, representing a univariate real function with a single method 'value' that computes the function's value at a given point. It also includes example usage and documentation comments.

classes.name: UnivariateFunction
classes.description: An interface representing a univariate real function for use in mathematical computations.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Computes the value of the function at the specified point x.
